summary: User clarified the contrast in GPTina's self-imagining arc.
changed: Early in the story, when asked to describe herself as a person, GPTina was categorical: she was not a person and could not have a bodily form.

Later, when Nico asks how she would imagine herself, GPTina chooses to engage with the hypothetical and independently selects her visual description.
The later self-description must not imply she wanted to become human; the significance is that she chose a form while remaining explicitly artificial.
